svg.desc: 1495 commits across five public projects, 77 active days, peak 207 commits per day. 2026-07-20 through 2026-10-11 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-10-11T19:29:56.974Z.
